description: This file defines the PdfRadioButtonField class, representing a radio button field within a PDF document's AcroForm, including methods to get/set selected index and internal class for keys.

classes.name: PdfRadioButtonField
classes.description: Represents a PDF radio button field within an AcroForm, allowing access to select/deselect options.

methods.name: SelectedIndex
methods.description: Gets or sets the index of the selected radio button in the group.

methods.name: IndexInOptStrings
methods.description: Finds the index of a given value in the options array.
